Looking for weird romance anime, bizarre love stories, and the most unusual anime couples ever created? These 10 romance anime take a normal love story and turn it into something absolutely INSANE!

From a girlfriend whose saliva creates a bizarre emotional connection to a zombie romance, a human falling for a beastfolk classmate, and a boy whose girlfriend is literally his right hand… these anime prove that romance in anime can get REALLY weird.

But here's the twist: some of these ridiculous premises lead to genuinely wholesome, heartbreaking, and unforgettable love stories.
